The mayor says the silence keeps us {g:safe.}
It came from the old factory
and sent them through the wires.
And the monster in the forest
The silence was never to keep us safe.
It was so she could {r:never} hear it.
On the cage was a sign.
The baby crawled into my arms,
Lights turned on in every house.
I walked right up to her,
Then the baby jumped into her arms,
Then she turned to the mayor,
waves at me from the forest.
He's the only one in town
